text_block_list.text: (Shaaaa—...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmmph, it started raining...!
And right after I finished shopping too~...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Is there somewhere we can take shelter from the rain—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a place I've been curious about
for a while now. Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm,
was the planetarium where you wanted to go?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there's a special event going on—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, looks like it's starting. Let's just watch for now!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The moon, casting its mystical glow,
possesses a magic-like power――"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What's this, talking about the moon...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—One of those is gravitational pull. It has a tremendous effect on the Earth, such as the ebb and flow of the tides."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh, really...?! I knew it, the moon really does hold great power! Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Not bad, Kitasan!
That was super interesting♪"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Really?
I'm glad you like it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When we went shopping earlier,
you bought something that looked like a moon rock, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Besides, you said before that the moon has a special magical power, so I thought you'd be interested.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, good eye♪
The one I just bought is a moonstone!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's a stone imbued with lunar power. If what they're saying is true,
it might hold incredible magical energy♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Super magical power, huh~……!
I can't wait to see what kind of magic happens!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right? As thanks for today, I wouldn't mind
showing it to you first.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I'm so glad!
I'll be looking forward to it!
And, as the two stepped outside—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, the moon...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait, no way!? Where, where...ed!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Look, right there!
It's kind of hidden behind the utility pole, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, I have no clue at all!
Where?! Where is it~?!
